title: woodsia subcordata var. longifolia
intro: Woodsia subcordata var. longifolia, commonly known as Long-leaf Woodsia, is a type of fern that belongs to the genus Woodsia and is native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its therapeutic actions as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Woodsia subcordata var. longifolia include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential applications of this plant in traditional medicine.
